habitat: Arid savanna to mesic woodland; riverine forest; and areas with tall trees for breeding
story: In the diverse world of birds, the Verreaux Eagle Owl (Ketupa lactea) stands out. This species, part of the Strigidae family, is a resident of Arid savanna to mesic woodland; riverine forest; and areas with tall trees for breeding. Its IUCN Red List status is Least Concern (LC), which serves as a call to action for habitat preservation. The Verreaux Eagle Owl is more than just a bird; it is a symbol of the rich biodiversity that we must protect. Through this poster, we hope to foster a greater understanding and appreciation for the Verreaux Eagle Owl and its role in the ecosystem.
Every poster is crafted to inspire curiosity about our planet's incredible biodiversity.
